# Proto-Gospel of James Chapter 25 — The EMET Bible (Literal)

**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** P.Bodmer V / Greek MSS, Proto-Gospel of James 25 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/POX_025_page_001.jpg

---

## Chapter 25

**25:1** Now there was a great commotion among the priests when Zechariah was not found at the appointed time, how he should respond to them in the service of God. So there was taken a vessel of water and a prayer was offered, that God might reveal his face. And they cast lots, and the lot fell to Simeon.

**25:2** And Simeon was told by the Holy Spirit that he would not see death until he had first seen Christ incarnate. And when the child was brought in to the temple, he saw the child and recognized him, and said: "Lord, now let your servant depart in peace, for my eyes have seen your salvation."

**25:3** And it was I, James, who wrote this history in Jerusalem. And when the tumult arose at the death of Herod, I withdrew into the wilderness until the commotion had ceased, giving glory to the Lord God who gave me this gift and this wisdom.

**25:4** Peace be to the one who fears the Lord. Amen.

---

*[Scribal colophon — P.Bodmer V:] The Birth of Mary. Revelation of James. Peace to the one who sent it and to the one who reads it.*
